name: Evacuate
detailed_description:
IN DEVELOPMENT
Evacuate is a 3D first-person survival horror puzzle game where you wake up inside the M.O.R.S. research facility after a containment breach has turned everyone around you into zombies. You’re alone, unarmed, and the only way out is through a locked-down maze of puzzles, broken systems, and hungry infected.

You’ll solve logic-based puzzles like fuse panels and code-locked doors while managing limited resources and sneaking (or fighting) your way past enemies that actually react to sound and movement. Each zone in the facility builds tension with more complex challenges and ends with a major puzzle sequence instead of a traditional boss fight. Every moment is designed to keep you thinking and sweating.

What to expect:

• Puzzle-heavy gameplay with keypads, fuses, torn memos, and environmental clues
• Stealth and combat options — sneak past threats or fight when you have to
• Enemies that hear your footsteps, chase you down, and cut off escape routes
• A fully designed facility with distinct zones that escalate in difficulty
• Collectible lore notes and voice logs that fill in the backstory
• Inventory management that forces tough choices about ammo, keycards, and more
• Dynamic lighting, spatial audio, and high-quality 3D visuals that bring the horror to life

Can you survive long enough to piece together what went wrong... and evacuate?

short_description: A first-person survival horror puzzle game where you wake up in a zombie-infested research facility. Solve environmental puzzles, manage resources, and escape while evading enemies that hunt by sound and movement.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of violence, gore, and horror elements. Players must evade hostile zombie-like enemies that will attempt to kill the player character. The game includes tense survival situations, blood effects, and disturbing environmental storytelling. Viewer discretion is advised.
